content:
Sam T: Received invoice INV-2026-001 from Nimbus Dataworks for $124,750. Header shows vendor name 'NimbusDW' and no PO. PDF: https://s3.company/nimbus/INV-2026-001.pdf — vendor says payment due in 15 days.
Priya M: Coupa lookup: there's a draft PO 121900 for Nimbus Dataworks, Inc tied to the Analytics SOW but it's in Draft waiting on SOW/Legal. Can't match yet.
Ravi S: If PO isn't approved we can't auto-match in NetSuite. Vendor threat to suspend feeds complicates — need to decide risk to business.
Sam T: Vendor email attached: "This invoice reconciles final usage Oct-Dec. If unpaid we'll suspend data feeds after due date." Link to vendor email in ticket.
Leah P: Business sponsor for the SOW is Marta C from Analytics, she's OOO today. Is there a delegate who can approve the SOW?
Ken W: I am listed as delegate on the delegation form. I can sign the SOW if Legal approves the redlines. Procurement, can you fast-track PO 121900?
procurement-bot: PO 121900 status: DRAFT. Action requested: expedite approval. Notified: legal@redwood, procurement-team. Suggested ETA: 24 hours.
invoices-bot: Invoice INV-2026-001 created in NetSuite (NS-INV-14567). Current status: "On Hold - PO Missing". Vendor requested 15-day payment term.
Ravi S: Finance options: (1) insist vendor reissue with PO# and wait (risk suspension), (2) accept one-off conditional payment with director sign-off and then match when PO is approved, (3) request vendor extension. Director approval required for >$50k.
Sam T: Vendor replied: "We can extend payment by 7 days if PO is approved within that period."
Priya M: I'll ping Legal to confirm we can accept delegated signature and to prioritize the SOW review. Also I'll ask vendor to reissue with PO# or provide written confirmation tying the invoice to the SOW/PO draft.
Ken W: I approve fast-track delegate signature contingent on Legal sign-off. Legal, please respond here so procurement can update the PO state.
Legal: Confirmed. We'll review redlines and aim to sign the SOW by EOD tomorrow. Once signed, notify procurement to change PO 121900 to APPROVED.
procurement-bot: PO 121900 status updated to "Pending Signature". Estimated approval turnaround: ~20 hours.
invoices-bot: Action logged: Place invoice NS-INV-14567 on conditional approval hold. If PO 121900 is approved within 48h, auto-route invoice to Director for immediate payment. Notification set to finance-approvers.
Sam T: Great. Marking this thread pending PO approval and vendor extension confirmation. Will reopen if vendor pushes on service suspension.
